notes.NHL: NHL rows are club rosters; a player with no NHL games this season has gp 0 and a blank nhle.
notes.Names: Names are matched to Fantrax exactly once accents, apostrophes, hyphens and spacing are ignored (O'Reilly = OReilly). Only KHL, VHL and MHL names, which are transliterated from Russian, also match across spellings (Dmitry/Dmitri) and word order. A goalie only matches a goalie, and a forward never matches a Fantrax defenceman (or the reverse).
notes.Russia: VHL and MHL names are transliterated from Russian and matched to Fantrax by name only (no birthdates), so common names can collide: verify before acting on a VHL/MHL match.
notes.Ages: The ak column says how an age is known: 'dob' = from a real birthdate, 'est' = estimated (NCAA class year when the roster page has no birthdate), blank = no age (Allsvenskan, J20, VHL, MHL). Rows with no age rank below rows with one in avail, und and risers.
notes.Draft: dr: 'post' = an NHL club holds him or his real birthdate shows he has been through an NHL draft; 'pre' = no NHL club and not yet through a draft (never claimable); blank = unknown (no real birthdate). Estimated ages never decide dr.
notes.Matches: mq 'amb' = the same Fantrax player was matched to more than one person and none is clearly the real one: verify before acting. Namesakes that could be told apart lost their match and are listed under checks.dropped; rows with no age whose Fantrax id belongs to veterans are listed under checks.veteran and kept out of avail, und and risers.
notes.PPP: ppp is power-play points where the league publishes them and power-play goals otherwise; blank where it publishes neither. The `ppp` map says which per league ('points', 'goals' or 'none').
notes.Claims: Ownership comes from the next scoring period, so claims made this week already count. If that fell back to the current period, notes.Fantrax says so.
notes.FreeAgents: avail, und, risers and unowned goalies list only players Fantrax itself shows as free agents (FA) or on waivers (WW), counted from their first game. A player with no Fantrax id is never listed there: the best of those are under notInFx.
notes.Carried: A league whose status is 'carried YYYY-MM-DD' failed today: its rows are the ones from that date and the reason is under errors. Carried rows older than 7 days are dropped.
notes.Czech: Czech rows come from the NHL's player pages, not hokej.cz (which blocks automated readers): every player with an NHL id who has an Extraliga line this season, with real birthdates. Undrafted players with no NHL id are not covered.
notes.HfdMissing: hfdMissing lists HFD minors (next period's roster) that were not found in any scanned league.
notes.Stale: Possibly stale leagues (totals unchanged while others moved): Czech.
